The '''Vampire Witch Mask''' is an {{Epic}} [[Helmet]]. It's a fusion of the {{Item|Vampire Mask}} and {{Item|Witch Mask}}, granting both stats and bonuses.  All [[Enchantments]] and [[Reforging|Reforges]] on the {{Item|Vampire Mask}} are lost upon crafting, but those on the {{Item|Witch Mask}} are transferred.

== Tips ==
* Equipping the '''Vampire Witch Mask''' with a {{Item|Bat Person Talisman}} (or higher) will grant a small bonus to {{stat|def}}, {{stat|str}}, and {{stat|int}}.
* If a summoned bat kills a mob without the player's contribution, the kill will not be counted, nor will there be any combat xp.
**{{Ench|Scavenger}} only applies when the mob killed by the helmet's abilities has received damage from the player.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Vampire Witch Mask's''' appearance is the helmet of the [https://tolkiengateway.net/wiki/Witch-King_of_Angmar ''Witch King of Angmar''] from the [[w:Lord of the Rings (disambiguation)|''Lord of the Rings'']].
